content:
Maya: quick note  spotted noisy model flipflop on route /v1/chat where auto-fallback kept swapping between model-xl and model-xl-quant. users hit transient 502s. Proposal: add a per-route "swap-throttle" (aka quarantine window) that prevents back-to-back automated swaps for a short period. default 30s, configurable. prevents churn. reactions?

Kevin: +1. we should define behavior: fixed throttle vs. exponential backoff vs. circuit-breaker style (open -> half-open probe). I lean half-open probe: after quarantine expires allow a single probe request to evaluate before resuming swaps.

Tara: Console UX: show a subtle chip "Swap throttle active: 00:24" next to route name. actions: "Extend throttle" and "Force swap (reason required)". clicking Force shows a modal to capture operator rationale and an option to notify on-call. also show a condensed timeline of recent swaps.

Eli: infra plan: store `throttle_until` and `probe_allowed` on the decision record. policy fields: `throttle_ms`, `probe_after_ms`, `max_swaps_in_window`. Emit structured events: `swap_throttle.started`, `swap_throttle.probe_attempt`, `swap_throttle.forced` with metadata (route, from_model, to_model, cause_metric, actor).

Maya: telemetry: create aggregate metrics `swap_throttle.count`, `swap_throttle.probes`, `swap_flap_rate`. sample full KV traces during probes at a low rate (1%) for debugging. audit logs must capture operator overrides + attached reason text.

Kevin: tests: e2e harness should replay intermittent 502 bursts and assert no more than one model swap per throttle window and that probe attempts behave as expected. unit tests for probe acceptance/rejection logic.

Tara: microcopy: avoid words like "lockout". suggests: "Throttle active (prevents automatic swaps)" tooltip: "Temporarily prevents automated model changes to reduce instability. Operators can force a swap with justification." We'll provide copy for the modal and toast states.

Eli: API: decision service should return `swap_throttle_state:{active:true, remaining_ms:24000, probe_allowed:false, cause:"p95_latency"}` so console and Private/Dedicated planes can show status. Add preview flag `simulate-swap-throttle` for sandbox testing.

Maya: privacy/compliance: throttle-related events should be audited with user id, timestamp, and reason; retention same as rollout audit logs. also ensure reason strings are indexed for searching in the console.

Kevin: operational note: add a small shadowing option `shadow_sample_during_throttle_pct` to route a tiny fraction (e.g., 0.1%) to the candidate model for human review without affecting serving decisions. config per-route.

Tara: UI mock task: I'll add the chip, modal, and a small help panel "Why is swapping throttled?" linking to the decision trace and sampled shadow logs. modal will require a 20-char minimum reason on force.

Eli: opened a draft proto snippet: `message SwapThrottle { int64 throttle_ms = 1; int64 probe_ms = 2; double shadow_sample_pct = 3; repeated string triggers = 4; }` will iterate in PR.

Maya: I'll write a short RFC tonight covering policy schema, console visuals, telemetry, tests, and rollout plan. propose Fri 09:00 sync infra/design/qa.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary planned -> `swap-throttle-v1` -> 5% traffic on 2025-11-18T16:00Z. Watchboards: `swap_throttle.count`, `swap_flap_rate`, `model_swap_latency`.

Kevin: one more: add a dashboard alert when probe rejection rate > 50% within 10m, so PM/Eng get notified of persistent instability.

Maya: sounds good. will draft RFC and tag everyone.
